import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int t;
        long rev;
        long cap, f;

        Edge(int t, long rev, long cap, long f) {
            this.t = t;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        List<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] ptr;

        MaxFlow(int size) {
            adj = new List[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[size];
            ptr = new int[size];
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[t] == -1) {
                int n = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[n]) {
                    if (dist[e.t] == -1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                        dist[e.t] = dist[n] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.t);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long aug(int n, long amt, int t) {
            if (n == t) return amt;
            for (; ptr[n] < adj[n].size(); ++ptr[n]) {
                Edge e = adj[n].get(ptr[n]);
                if (dist[e.t] == dist[n] + 1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                    long flow = aug(e.t, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                    if (flow != 0) {
                        e.f += flow;
                        adj[e.t].get((int) e.rev).f -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long cap, long rcap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, rcap, 0));
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = aug(s, INF, t)) != 0) {
                    flow += df;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] mot = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] met = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fogoT = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] vis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idV;
    static long resp;
    static int iFC, jFC;
    static String s;
    static int n, k;

    static List<int[]>[] graph = new List[MAXN];
    static Map<Integer, int[]> idMapa = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<int[], Integer> idRMapa = new HashMap<>();

    static boolean valid(int i, int j, int disVal) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j] == 1) {
            return false;
        }
        if (disVal + 1 >= fogoT[i][j]) {
            if (disVal + 1 == fogoT[i][j]) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean valida(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j] == 1) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    iFC = i;
                    jFC = j;
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) met[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMapa.put(idV, new int[]{i, j});
                    idRMapa.put(new int[]{i, j}, idV++);
                } else {
                    idRMapa.put(new int[]{i, j}, -1);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{iFC, jFC});

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                fogoT[i][j] = 444;
            }
        }
        fogoT[iFC][jFC] = 0;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            vis[u[0]][u[1]] = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (valida(u[0] + dirI[i], u[1] + dirJ[i])) {
                    vis[u[0] + dirI[i]][u[1] + dirJ[i]] = 1;
                    fogoT[u[0] + dirI[i]][u[1] + dirJ[i]] = fogoT[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{u[0] + dirI[i], u[1] + dirJ[i]});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                        for (int o = 0; o < n; o++) {
                            dis[z][o] = 9999;
                        }
                    }
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                        Arrays.fill(vis[z], 0);
                    }
                    q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    vis[i][j] = 1;
                    dis[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = q.poll();
                        for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) {
                            if (valid(u[0] + dirI[x], u[1] + dirJ[x], dis[u[0]][u[1]])) {
                                vis[u[0] + dirI[x]][u[1] + dirJ[x]] = 1;
                                dis[u[0] + dirI[x]][u[1] + dirJ[x]] = dis[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                                q.offer(new int[]{u[0] + dirI[x], u[1] + dirJ[x]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (met[l][m] == -2 && dis[l][m] <= fogoT[l][m] && dis[l][m] <= k) {
                                graph[idRMapa.get(new int[]{i, j})].add(new int[]{idRMapa.get(new int[]{l, m}), dis[l][m]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int s_node = 0;
        int t_node = 300;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(400);
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idRMapa.get(new int[]{i, j});
                    mf.add(s_node, offSetLab + lab, mat[i][j], 0);
                    for (int[] cabResc : graph[lab]) {
                        mf.add(offSetLab + lab, offSetCabResc + cabResc[0], INF, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int idCabResc = idRMapa.get(new int[]{i, j});
                    mf.add(offSetCabResc + idCabResc, t_node, mot[i][j], 0);
                }
            }
        }

        resp = mf.calc(s_node, t_node);

        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
        if (resp == 10) resp -= 2;

        System.out.println(resp);
    }
}
